_comment: Building placement and construction (§12.1, §5.1b Heritage Projects), Phase 1 checkpoint 1e. All numbers are [TWEAK] placeholders.
_max_slope_comment: Largest ground-height difference allowed under a footprint (corners and tile centres). Placeholder; §12.1 gives no number.

path_access._comment: §12.1: a building's entrance must be next to a path. Players can't lay paths until checkpoint 1g, so for now a missing path is only a warning (people walk across the lawn or rough ground to the door). Set required to true once paths exist.

construction._comment: §12.1: small 3 months, medium 9 months, large 18-24 months (21 used), summer x1.5, winter x0.7. A building may set its own construction_months. Size class by footprint area in tiles. Paid in full when ordered (financing comes with the budget, 1i).
construction._cancel_comment: Cancelling a site refunds this share of the unspent part (cost x work left); same-day cancels refund everything.

heritage._comment: Heritage Projects (§5.1b, §5.4): real buildings offered from a few years before their real build year. Building one on its real site (enough of the footprint overlapping the real outline) earns a small Heritage bonus, recorded until the Heritage score exists.
